concerns.text: T013a/b (Tool Validation) is marked [P] and placed before T014 (Static Analysis), but T013b explicitly requires fetching GitHub star counts for the *specific repos* selected in T010. T010 (Repo Selection) must complete before T013b can execute. Marking T013b as parallel-safe with T010 is a hidden dependency violation.

T015 (Preprocessing) depends on T014 (Static Analysis) output, but T014 depends on T011 (Git History) and T010 (Repo Selection). The task list groups T010-T015 as a single block, but T014 cannot run in parallel with T010/T011. The [P] tag on T014 is incorrect if it implies parallel execution with upstream data extraction.

T007a (Skeleton) is marked [P] and listed alongside T002-T006. However, T007b (Timeout Logic) and T007c (Error Handling) depend on the existence of the function stubs created in T007a. T007a must precede T007b/c. Grouping them as parallel-safe violates the producer-consumer flow within the `main.py` file.

T012 (Metadata Generation) is marked [X] (completed) and depends on T010. However, T010 is marked as [ ] (pending). This creates a logical ordering contradiction where a task depending on a pending task is marked complete. T012 should be pending or T010 should be marked complete.
